text:
morgan: Heads-up — noticed rendering glitch on kb/ops/alerting-oncall.md in prod docs site. Sidebar hangs and the page content isn't showing after the header. Suspect broken YAML frontmatter. :eyeglasses:

sasha: ugh, yep I can repro on staging. the HTML stops at the frontmatter parser. looks like the file ends with `---` missing or an unescaped colon. quick check: `sed -n '1,12p' kb/ops/alerting-oncall.md` shows the last `---` is gone.

kevin: can you paste the top of the file? might be from last mass-rename script. also run `npm run docs:lint` — the linter should fail with frontmatter error.

sasha: paste here: ```
title: Oncall alerting runbook
owner: ops:team
---
```

morgan: yep that `owner: ops:team` is the culprit (unquoted colon). the parser thinks `ops:team` is a mapping. quick fix is to quote it or change to `owner: "ops-team"`.

sasha: opened a tiny PR to fix and add a lint rule to catch this: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/3456 :thumbsup: includes a unit for frontmatter parser and a pre-commit hook tweak.

docs-bot: deploy-preview built — preview at https://deploy-preview-3456--kb.redwood.local. Build logs show `docs-lint` failed before fix, passed after.

maria: thanks for the patch. i'll review now. quick question — who should be listed as owner for that page? ops or oncall? we should standardize.

morgan: let's set `owner: ops` (no colon). also add a short note in the page about oncall rotation link. can you add that in the same PR?

sasha: yep i pushed an extra commit with owner -> "ops" and a one-line rotation link. ran `npm run docs:lint` locally, all green.

kevin: nice. after merge can someone run `rg "owner: .*:" -n kb/ || true` to find any other unquoted colons in frontmatter? i can run a quick script in CI but would be good to patch obvious ones.

morgan: i ran that grep and found two more files in `kb/platform/` — i'll open issues for them.

maria: reviewed and approved PR. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: pull request #3456 merged by maria. production docs redeployed — live now.

morgan: great — thanks y'all. follow-up: ticket to add a docs-lint rule for unquoted colon patterns and add a short checklist for frontmatter before bulk imports. i'll add to the docs board. :memo:

sasha: sounds good. adding a one-liner test in CI to catch `owner: .*:`, will send a tiny PR after lunch.

kevin: thanks — that should reduce noise. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
